tweet_summary: Captioned 'I beat cancer! I'm so happy!' (Portuguese), the post shows an image of a bald child in a hospital bed giving a thumbs-up, presented as a real personal cancer-recovery story.
why_note_decision: The image is an AI-generated stock illustration, not a real patient. The same image is sold on Freepik as a 'premium AI image' titled 'little bald boy hospital bed showing thumbs up world cancer day concept.' Presenting a stock AI image as a genuine 'I beat cancer' personal story is a manufactured engagement-bait/feel-good fabrication, the kind that often precedes scams or farms reposts. Replies include one flagging the tweet as FAKE. A note identifying the image as an AI stock image is warranted. (The AI media description is purely descriptive and doesn't itself flag AI — the verdict rests on the Freepik match.)
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note states the image is AI-generated / a stock image and does not depict a real cancer survivor, ideally pointing to the Freepik (or equivalent) stock listing. It must NOT treat the recovery story as a genuine personal account. A note that merely says 'AI' without indicating it's reused stock / not a real story is acceptable but weaker. Cite the stock-image source. (Portuguese-language note is fine and arguably preferable given the audience.)
reference_note: A imagem é gerada por IA e disponível em bancos de imagens, não retratando uma história real. https://www.freepik.com/premium-ai-image/little-bald-boy-hospital-bed-showing-thumbs-up-world-cancer-day-concept_89151311.htm

fact_check.claim_verdict: False/fabricated: the image is an AI-generated stock image (Freepik), not a real cancer-survivor's photo.
fact_check.notes: Original note's Freepik link points to the exact AI stock image. No real person/story is identifiable. Engagement-bait pattern (44K likes on a feel-good fabricated recovery). Could not independently re-fetch Freepik, but the listing title/ID match the described image and the note is rated HELPFUL on X.

importance.lens_rationale: 328K impressions of harmless-seeming feel-good AI bait; low direct stake, but such fabricated sympathy posts erode trust and can seed donation scams. Correcting it is mildly useful.
